messages.FLEA_MISSING_PAYMENT_ITEMS: Purchase blocked: the request omitted its payment items. Required: {requiredPayment}. Available: {availablePayment}.
messages.INSUFFICIENT_FLEA_FUNDS: Purchase blocked: insufficient funds. Required: {requiredPayment}. Available: {availablePayment}.
messages.FLEA_PAYMENT_SCHEME_MISMATCH: Purchase blocked: the submitted payment does not match the server-required offer payment ({requiredPayment}).
messages.FLEA_INVALID_PAYMENT_ASSET: Purchase blocked: payment contains an item that is not owned or not valid.
messages.FLEA_OFFER_NOT_FOUND: Purchase blocked: this offer no longer exists.
messages.FLEA_INVALID_QUANTITY: Purchase blocked: requested quantity is invalid or exceeds the offer quantity.
messages.FLEA_PAYMENT_REQUIREMENTS_UNKNOWN: Purchase blocked: the server could not verify this offer's payment requirements.
messages.FLEA_SELF_PURCHASE: Purchase blocked: you cannot purchase your own offer.
messages.FLEA_PRICE_TOO_HIGH: Purchase blocked: {itemTpl} is listed at {priceRatio}x its trusted reference ({transactionValueRub} vs {assetValueRub} RUB).
messages.FLEA_PRICE_TOO_LOW: Purchase blocked: {itemTpl} is priced far below its trusted reference range.
messages.TRADER_PAYMENT_SCHEME_MISMATCH: Purchase blocked: payment does not match the trader's live server-side scheme.
messages.TRADER_STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Purchase blocked: the trader has insufficient stock for the requested quantity.
messages.TRADER_BUY_RESTRICTION_EXCEEDED: Purchase blocked: the trader's native purchase limit has been reached.
messages.TRADER_SELL_PAYOUT_TOO_HIGH: Sale blocked: the payout exceeds the server-side valuation limit.
messages.FENCE_ABSOLUTE_PAYOUT_CAP: Sale blocked: the Fence payout exceeds the configured safety cap.
messages.PLAYER_PURCHASE_POLICY_RESTRICTED: Purchase blocked: this item has a temporary administrator restriction for your profile.
messages.PLAYER_BLOCKLISTED: Purchase blocked: this profile is suspended from all purchases by the server administrator. {caseId}
messages.ITEM_BLOCKLISTED: Purchase blocked: this item is restricted by the server administrator. {caseId}
